sentence: A signup list of airport pickups and drop-offs where each trip gets one driver, first to claim wins, and only that driver can give it back.
use_when: A group needs to sort out who drives each airport pickup or drop-off
Each ride needs exactly one volunteer driver
People want to see which trips are still open
Riders need to add a short note like a time change to a trip
dont_use_when: Splitting costs or gas money between riders
Picking a time or date that works for everyone
Tracking a general chore or task list with many assignees per item
